name: Right Now
tagline: Fresh off the For You page

cards.name: Egg Bandit
cards.caption: Steal an egg. Run.
cards.flavor: Aug–Oct 2026: Roblox's Steal an Egg peaked near 14M players at once. Grab. Hatch. Run.
cards.art: Chubby speckled egg in a black bandit eye-mask with tiny legs, sprinting while carrying a smaller golden egg, sweat drops, a treadmill behind. Background: grassy farm. Colors: cream, black, gold, grass green.

cards.name: Huss Valley Runner
cards.caption: Why he keep coming back?
cards.flavor: July 2026: frantic running clips got a name, 'hussing', and their own Roblox valley.
cards.art: Faceless blue stick-figure runner with exaggerated pumping arms and knees, big sweat drops and breath puffs, racing down a winding green valley road past an arrow signpost. Colors: blue, valley green, road gray, white.

cards.name: Round Raccoon
cards.caption: Built like a dinner roll
cards.flavor: July 2026's Meme of the Month: Jimothy, the round (and healthy) Seattle raccoon.
cards.art: Very round, compact raccoon like a fluffy ball on short legs, bandit mask, calm unbothered face, waddling across a lawn. Background: green lawn and wooden fence. Colors: gray, black, cream, green.

cards.name: The Nothing Special
cards.caption: For example, nothing
cards.flavor: World Cup summer 2026: a star's 'special' recipe was 'for example, nothing.'
cards.art: Fancy silver cloche lifted by a tiny chef's hat with stick arms, revealing a completely empty white plate with one sparkle. Background: red-check tablecloth. Colors: silver, white, red, black.

cards.name: La Peace Stone
cards.caption: La peace be with you
cards.flavor: Aug 2026: a Minecraft stream misread 'lapis lazuli' and gave the world 'la peace.'
cards.art: Deep blue gemstone with gold flecks meditating cross-legged with serene closed eyes and a soft halo, floating above a plain gray cube. Background: calm lavender gradient. Colors: lapis blue, gold, lavender, white.

cards.name: Hippo Jacuzzo
cards.caption: Do not disturb. Bubbling.
cards.flavor: Sept 2026: Steal a Brainrot's OG Craft event added a hippo with its own hot tub.
cards.art: Lavender-gray hippo lounging in a round bubbling hot tub, cucumber slices on its eyes, a rubber duck floating, steam swirls. Background: tiled spa. Colors: hippo lavender, aqua, white bubbles, yellow.

cards.name: Car From Chile
cards.caption: Cars in Chile be like
cards.flavor: Sept 2026: Chile is long and thin, so the internet decided everything there is too.
cards.art: Absurdly long, skinny cartoon car stretching diagonally across the whole card, tiny wheels every few inches, a driver window at each end, mountains behind. Colors: cherry red, road gray, sky blue, snowy white.

cards.name: Bukangi
cards.caption: Won't leave the harbor
cards.flavor: Busan, Sept 2026: a shark parked in a harbor canal, got a cute name and 10k fans a day.
cards.art: Friendly gray shark with rosy cheeks and a tiny sailor cap poking its head out of a narrow canal, crowd of tiny phone-camera flashes on the bank, harbor bridge silhouette. Colors: shark gray, sea blue, pink, yellow.

cards.name: Totally Not Verity
cards.caption: Every smiley is Verity
cards.flavor: Summer 2026: a Minecraft horror series made kids yell 'Verity!' at every smiley face.
cards.art: Plain yellow ball smiley with dot eyes and a slightly-too-wide smile, faint suspicious glow, surrounded by ordinary smileys. Background: dark forest green. Colors: smiley yellow, black, forest green, white.

cards.name: Clapback Cat
cards.caption: Wow. Great job. Really.
cards.flavor: Late Sept 2026: an AI black cat with human hands slowly applauding your bad choices.
cards.art: Glossy black cat with big yellow eyes and a smug closed-mouth smile, two oversized white cartoon hands clapping, clap marks. Background: flat chroma-key green. Colors: black, yellow, white, bright green.

cards.name: November Bear
cards.caption: Remember November...
cards.flavor: Sept 2026: an AI polar bear sings a cryptic 'prophecy' about November 2026. Why?
cards.art: White polar bear standing in snow at night, singing with eyes closed and one paw raised dramatically, a calendar page reading 'NOV' floating behind, aurora in the sky. Colors: white, navy, aurora green, red.

cards.name: Tiptoe Stiltskin
cards.caption: Tip-toein' in my kicks
cards.flavor: Oct 2026: a fake-80s AI fairy-tale imp tiptoe-dances while straw turns to gold.
cards.art: Small bearded imp in a pointy felt hat and patched tunic tiptoeing with knees high and arms swinging, straw pile turning into gold coins behind him. Background: sepia castle room. Colors: brown, gold, forest green, sepia.
